en.hubeali:
Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the man extracts the Zakāt from his wealth, then specifies it for a particular group of people, but it gets wasted, or he sends with it/him to them, but it gets wasted, so there is nothing upon him’.
en.sarwar: 2. Hammad ibn ‘Isa has narrated from Hariz from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one takes out his Zakat and assigns it to be paid to a people but it is lost, or he sends it to them and it is lost, he is not held responsible.’”
